audience: support teams that answer website visitors in Crisp

useCases.title: List unread and unresolved conversations
useCases.text: List conversations filtered by unread or unresolved state, or search them by text. Open one to read its state.

useCases.title: Read a visitor's details and messages
useCases.text: Read the nickname, email and subject of a conversation's visitor. List its latest messages, or page back to older ones.

useCases.title: Check the operators of a website
useCases.text: Read the website this token is scoped to. List its operators to see who can answer chats.

useCases.title: Reply to a visitor and set the state
useCases.text: Read the latest messages first. Send an operator reply, which the visitor receives. Then set the conversation to pending, unresolved or resolved.

useCases.title: Add an internal note to a conversation
useCases.text: Add a note that the visitor does not see. Use it to hand over context to a colleague.
